answer.reason: The verses tell two chief events of this Pharaoh: taking Sarai into his house and being plagued by the LORD because of her.

clauses.quote: the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house

clauses.english: was plagued by the LORD with great plagues because of Sarai
clauses.quote: the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues

clauses.english: sent Abram away with his wife and all that he had
clauses.quote: they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had

doubts: Pharaoh's rebuke of Abram (GEN 12:18-19) is folded into the sending away rather than given its own clause.
Verse 12:15 says Sarai was taken by Pharaoh's house, with Pharaoh's princes commending her; the clause says he took her, which the text supports only loosely.
